description: Decide whether a player should buy a specific game, from their own library: whether they already own it, how many barely-played games in the same genres they own (with examples), and today's best price against the all-time low. Returns a verdict: owned, play_first, wait, or go.

game.description: The name of the game being considered, e.g. 'Elden Ring'.

profile.description: A Steam profile URL (steamcommunity.com/id/name or /profiles/7656...), a custom URL name, or a SteamID64. The profile's Game details must be public.

name: should_i_buy_game
title: Should I buy this game?
